title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
About the role
Build local AI features for document-heavy workflows. You will work with Python, LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation, evaluate retrieval quality and present evidence to reviewers.

We use AWS for internal tooling.

Requirements:
- Python
- LLM
- RAG
- NLP
- Statistics
- 1+ years of experience with Python

Preferred:
- Docker
- PyTorch
- Experience with agent frameworks

We require a master's degree and the right to work in Spain. Production experience is a plus.
